intro: My happy place is when I get to be outdoors and do two things I really love, hiking and photography. Astrophotography is something I am trying to get better at as well as portrait photography. I also enjoyed being behind the camera instead of being in front of it. In a world where selfies are dominating the gram, I encourage people to turn the phone around and see the world beyond themselves.
